items.title: SELF-INFECT
items.placementTarget: Back of each player reference card
items.text:
SELF-INFECT
At PEARL, scratch off exposures until you reveal a scar symbol or die.
If you reveal a scar, add a Carrier scar to your character.

mechanics.effect: Scratch off exposures until you reveal a scar symbol or die. If you reveal a scar, add a Carrier scar to your character.
restrictions: Stop when a scar symbol is revealed or the character dies
A revealed scar adds a Carrier scar, not a normal scar

items.title: Reference card placement
items.text: Place this sticker on the back of each player reference card.

mechanics.effect: Place the action sticker on the back of each player reference card.

summary: Self-Infect action overlay for PEARL: scratch exposures until a scar symbol or death, and a scar adds a Carrier scar. Place it on the back of each player reference card. The door numeral is printed rotated 90° counter-clockwise. Guid 00444a is also the placement strip on door 39.
